reviews.text: Sean was very professional and hands-on with my puppy Ralph (miniature Dachshund). We did the 5-class training package and started when Ralph was just 3 months old. With Sean’s guidance, Ralph has grown into the loveliest most obedient little pup! Highly recommend working with Sean.

Sean is a great dog trainer. He was very patient and spent a long time getting to know our dog. His techniques worked brilliantly and the training was actually a lot quicker than I was expecting. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone with a new puppy, and in fact I have already done so! We will certainly also continue to see Sean for training refreshers for our dog as he did such a good job with him initially.

I booked a 2-session package and completed 1 session, but my second session was cancelled by Sean on the same day.
As I was going away soon, rearranging wasn’t practical, so I requested a refund for the unused session.
Despite multiple follow-ups, communication was slow and I had to chase for a response. The refund was eventually processed, but the overall handling of the cancellation and refund process was disorganised and unprofessional.

Sean was a great help with recall training for my 11month old mini Schnauzer. Two telephone consultations with clear and practical training steps followed up by 1 2 1 reinforcement. Very good result and I will certainly be back to Sean next time we have another training issue.

Sean was very kind and patient with us when training our English bulldog, it's made a massive difference to her walks and it's now more relaxed and find for both of us. Even 3 months on we're noticing improvements so the techniques do work longer term as well.

Sean is a very good and knowledgeable trainer who understands dog behaviour and motivation. He clearly explains how to gently and patiently change a dog, especially a puppy. I had very good results working with Sean. I highly recommend him.
Sean knows dogs a lot. He is great. But Sean does not do working dogs very well. If you have a lovely mutt go for it.if you have a working dog, discuss/look elsewhere.
Sean is an excellent trainer. Thorough explanations and demonstrations. Milo responds really well to his training and we have very much enjoyed learning from Sean.

Sean’s training, support and advice has been invaluable and we couldn’t recommend him highly enough. He helped us to prepare for and settle in our brand new puppy, and then progressed to obedience training as our puppy grew. His genuine love of dogs comes through everything he does. We booked a block of five sessions, and then booked a couple more as different issues came up for our dog. He was always on hand for queries in between sessions and made sure all his sessions were tailored to exactly what we needed. The whole process has been a joy and we have a very happy dog!
Sean has been a massive help in showing us the best way to train our puppy, giving invaluable advice both in lessons and via message when we need it. 10/10

Sean gave us practical and easy to follow instructions which lead to noticeable progress within a couple of sessions. He also helped us to understand the realistic timescales for making progress. He was very supportive and he brought his own dog Charlie along to help us train our dog.

Sean was a brilliant help with our rescue pup, Pippin. He helped us understand our (recently arrived and terrified!) dog better, and establish fundamental techniques to build a strong bond and the foundations of obedience training.

Sean always provides thougtful advice and practical solutions for every challenge we encountered- and his calm demeaner helped us relax and enjoy the process of training and living with our new arrival.

We booked Sean for an inital 5 sessions, but plan to book more as our dog grows and develops.

My toy poodle Ollie had 5 sessions with Shaun. Ollie was always pleased to see Shaun and this made for enjoyable sessions. He is now able to respond to all basic commands. I found the notes after each practical session that he sent very useful as it helped me to work through the training sessions with more confidence. Ollie has learnt a lot In these sessions and hopefully this will continue as he grows and matured into an adult dog. Thank you to Shaun!

I have a 4 month old Chow Chow puppy, and so I had 5 sessions with Sean to teach her the basics. With Sean’s help and advice, my stubborn, biting puppy learned how to sit, lay, play nicely, socialise and use the toilet outside. Sean not only taught my puppy, but he trained me to train her, and got me to understand the mind of my puppy better! Really recommend, he was very kind and encouraging!

WORTH EVERY PENNY!!. Sean has absolutely revolutionised my life with a new puppy. He was there at all times to answer any questions or doubts and catered each lesson accordingly. Couldn’t recommend him more. Will definitely be booking more sessions in the next few months for the next steps!!

I worked with Sean on my 16 month old Labrador retriever that seemed to lose all his focus with me after his castration and also during the 'teenage phase'. He made a world of difference not only building up strong obedience skills with my dog, but also built up my confidence with the training. We struggled a lot with lead walking and eye contact (as he found the outside environment a lot more interesting than me) and after 4 sessions with Sean, it has improved noticeably well, he is a different dog on the lead, with little to no pulling, but also strong eye contact that allows him to walk to heal with me and block out environmental distractions  - I would highly recommend!
